title: Symmetry Is Almost All You Need: Robust Stability with Uncertainty Induced by Symmetric SRG Regions
summary: This paper investigates the robust stability problem of a feedback system in the presence of uncertainties induced by graphical regions in the plane where the scaled relative graphs (SRGs) reside. Our main results are developed using a novel and intuitive concept, the Davis-Wielandt shell, together with its connection to SRGs and related variants. We first study a matrix robust nonsingularity (MRN) problem for two types of graphically induced uncertainty sets: one with prior information on $θ$ and one without.
